corrections.description: P25AF: body

edits.before: Preconditions include engine speed at least 2,000 rpm, coolant at or below 65 °C and absence of specified valve and water-pressure sensor circuit codes. The page's valve open/close wording is inconsistent between sections, so this article does not infer a precise command-direction rule.
edits.after: Preconditions include engine speed at least 2,000 rpm and absence of specified valve and water-pressure sensor circuit codes. The source pairs a coolant limit of 65 °C with 140 °F, an inconsistent conversion that needs verification. Its valve open/close wording also differs between sections, so neither a temperature conversion nor a precise command-direction rule should be assumed from this page alone.

limitations: This is an aggregation of independent AI peer-review records, not a new independent reading of their sources or certification of all 1,000 planned wave-04 manuscripts.
Counts are deduplicated article paths. The 60 deep checks are article-to-source relationships, not 60 unique source documents, and are included within the 110 body samples.

The ten additional batch-34 metadata/excerpt inspections and the two additional KJ citation-only checks do not increase body or deep-source counts. Eight of the nine batch-34 reclassifications rely on existing disclosures and author notes; P1791 alone received a new original-row check in review A.

Reviewer B selected batch-35 at 95 available drafts. Reviewer D selected batch-39 at 44 and batch-40 at 50 drafts. Reviewer E adds five later articles per batch without overlap; all other later or unsampled articles remain outside these reviews.

Body-only review does not independently verify every threshold, source row, model qualifier or repair statement. Source checks used the exact publisher PDF, HTML or image described in each individual record; not every check included original diagram pixels.

P1738 in review B was checked against page transcription; original diagram pixels could not be independently inspected. Review E used downloaded Mazda HTML after a fresh web-reader request returned 404.

Mirrored historical manufacturer material is not current VIN-specific OEM portal verification, supersession checking, manufacturer endorsement or hands-on vehicle diagnosis. No vehicle fitment, repair result or universal threshold is certified.

Source-review classification changes expose unresolved definition or applicability gaps; they do not resolve the underlying conflicts. Existing flags and disclosed source contradictions remain in force.

Article hashes and source-review states in this aggregate are a timestamped snapshot. Detailed reviewer reports preserve their own selection cutoffs and checks; later edits require their own validation.
The review reports do not select publication, establish live deployment, Google indexing, traffic or the overall 10,000-article target.
